messages:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up on the fused-attention variants — we saw a small but reproducible nondeterminism in the dropout-free path on H100s during the nightly longgen suite. digging in. :thinking:
Samir Patel: ugh ok. is it only dropout-free path or also fused-qkv?
Maya Chen: appears localized to the dropoutless execution path that skips the dropout kernel. fused-qkv path seems deterministic when using the same kernel selection, but the runtime picks a different kernel on H100 vs A100 depending on sequence & head size.
Linh Tran: do we have a repro harness? can we reproduce with a fixed RNG seed and isolated batch=1, seq=512?
Maya Chen: yes — I added a small script to the infra tests that runs 1000 determinism checks across seeds. commands:```bash
# reproducibility check
./tools/run_determinism_check \
  --model open-7b-fused \
  --kernels fused_qkv,dropoutless \
  --seed 42 \
  --length 512 \
  --trials 1000
```
Maya Chen: On H100 this yields ~0.6% mismatches (token-level), on A100 ~0.01%.
Jules Rivera: mismatch rate 0.6% is concerning but small. what kind of mismatch? single token diffs or drift over sequence?
Maya Chen: most are single-token divergences early (token 2-10), then downstream drift. looks like a race/atomic op nondeterminism in the dropoutless attention write path.
Samir Patel: could be an atomic add in the KV cache update or fused softmax reduction using non-associative FP ops. H100's newer SMs do different warp scheduling.
Linh Tran: we should gate deterministic-critical workloads. Proposal: add a deterministic boolean to kernel selection policy. fallback to a stricter (but a bit slower) kernel for deterministic flag.
Maya Chen: agreed. also need to emit telemetry: kernel_choice, kernel_deterministic=true/false, and determinism_violation events with sample hashes so customers can correlate.
Samir Patel: how do we ensure backward compat? customers may rely on the faster nondet path today.
Maya Chen: rollout plan idea: add runtime flag feature_gate.deterministic_inference default=false. Console exposes per-model override and rollout % for orgs. Steps: 0% -> 5% canary -> 25% -> 100%.
Jules Rivera: aside — add a unit test in runtime/test/kernels/ that runs the native kernels under thread sanitizer? might be expensive but can be nightly.
Linh Tran: implementing deterministic flag in kernel selector is straightforward: prefer kernels with deterministic attribute or those that avoid atomic ops. but we need kernel-level metadata (deterministic:true/false).
Samir Patel: right — update kernel registry schema: add "deterministic" tag and a per-kernel perf_penalty estimate so selector can tradeoff.
Maya Chen: sample kernel registry entry idea:```json
{
  "name": "fused_attn_v2",
  "arch": "sm_90",
  "deterministic": "false",
  "throughput_tokens_per_sec": "12000"
}
```
Maya Chen: For older GPUs we mark deterministic:true if the implementation uses deterministic reductions.
Jules Rivera: We also need an automated diff comparator for outputs — hashing full sequence output vs reference so we can classify bitflip vs drift. We should store sample outputs in s3 (with ACL) for internal debugging.
Linh Tran: agreed. suggest a "determinism-bucket" with per-test metadata: model, seed, hw, kernel_choice, output_hash.
Samir Patel: perf impact? do we have numbers for strict deterministic kernels?
Maya Chen: early numbers: deterministic fused path is ~7-12% slower on avg for 512-length across our benchmark set. worst-case 20% on small heads.
Jules Rivera: 7-12% seems acceptable for customers who need determinism (finance/compliance). We should make it an opt-in SLA knob.
Samir Patel: also think about canary gating: if we flip deterministic flag at model rollout time we should run canary comparisons (A/B evaluate likelihood/perplexity + latency).
Linh Tran: instrumentation todo: add kernel_choice and determinism_tag to per-request trace. add a regression alert if determinism_violation_rate > 0.1% over 1h window.
Maya Chen: ops playbook snippet:```text
If determinism_violation_rate > 0.1%:
  - pause rollout
  - collect 10 failing traces
  - force kernel selector -> deterministic:true for affected model
  - trigger oncall (eng-runtime)
```
Samir Patel: implementation plan: (1) kernel metadata + registry change, (2) selector preference flag, (3) Console rollout toggle + telemetry, (4) infra harness + nightly s390 repros. estimate 2 sprints.
Jules Rivera: +1. add a short RFC update for perf tradeoffs and add the new telemetry schema.
Maya Chen: I'll draft RFC patch and put PR for the registry change. will also push the determinism check script to ci/longgen and a nightly job.
BuildBot: CI: determinism-check (nightly) started at 2024-07-05T04:10:00Z — running 1000 trials.
Samir Patel: thanks. can you add a quick note to eng-runtime on-console docs so platform teams know the knob exists?
Maya Chen: will do. adding a Console screenshot and rollout steps in the RFC PR. :memo:
thread_summary: Follow-up on nondeterminism in dropout-free fused attention path; propose deterministic kernel flag, kernel registry metadata, telemetry, rollout plan, and infra tests.
